title: ia-utils derived_outline import payload
description: JSON payload accepted by `ia-utils outline-import`. Each work gets one payload; entries are a tree of self-contained nodes, each carrying its own leaf range. Schema-compatible with iiif-utils' derived_outline. See docs/outline.md.

work.description: The work's canonical id. Matches the IA `identifier` from document_metadata, or — if absent — the sqlite filename stem.

entries.description: Top-level entries. Each entry's `level` must be 0 (root); children nest under via `children`.

level.description: Depth in the tree. Top-level entries are 0; each level of nesting adds 1. Must equal the nesting depth — redundant with the tree shape, but kept explicit so each row stands alone.

title.description: Native heading as the work announces it, verbatim. May be 'CONTENTS', 'Inhalt', 'Chapter VI — The Spinal Cord', 'Plate XI', 'Liber I, Caput III'. No normalization.

canvas_start.description: First leaf (page_numbers.leaf_num) of this entry's range.

canvas_end.description: Last leaf of this entry's range. Must be >= canvas_start.

printed_page_start.description: Printed page label where this entry begins. Usually an arabic page number (integer), but may be a string for Roman-numeral front matter ('VII'), letter pagination ('a', 'g'), or plate labels ('Plate I', 'Tafel I-X'). Null when no printed label exists.

printed_page_end.description: Printed page label where this entry ends. Same type rules as printed_page_start. Often derivable from the entry's canvas_end via reverse-lookup into page_numbers.

notes.description: Short human-readable caveat. For things like 'synthetic root, work has no titled heading', 'TOC printed as 10⁰, interpolated as 109', 'extracted from caption on leaf 47'. Not for prose summaries or queryable provenance taxonomy. NULL is the common case.

children.description: Nested sub-entries. Each child's [canvas_start, canvas_end] must lie within this entry's range. Omit or pass [] for leaf entries.
